controls.label: Change in the price of A (%)

readouts.v: {kind==0 ? "supply of A fell" : "demand for A rose"}

predict.q: The price of good A rises. What happens to the price of good B?

options.fb: Your answer fits only one link. Try the others: the type of link decides which curve shifts in market B.

options.s: It depends on how A and B are linked
options.fb: Each link moves a different curve in market B, so B's price can rise or fall.

task: Choose a link and move the "price of A" slider. Watch both markets. Then try the other links. For the demand links, A is dearer because its supply fell; for joint supply, because demand for A rose.

target.do: Move the price of A slider to the right, then press Check.

takeaway: The type of link decides which curve shifts in market B, and which way.
explore: Complements: D(B) left, price down. Substitutes: D(B) right, price up. Joint supply: S(B) right, price down. Competitive supply: S(B) left, price up.
